supporting_evidence.text:
This document specifies the service attributes of an Ethernet Virtual Connection (EVC) delivered by a Service
Provider to a Subscriber.

Each Subscriber SHALL have an IMSI and an MSISDN. The Subscriber's MSISDN is an E.164 number such as
+447700900123.

This document specifies the service attributes of an Ethernet Virtual Connection (EVC) delivered by a Service
Provider to a Subscriber. The EVC is an association of two or more UNIs that limits the exchange of Service
Frames.
| EIR | Integer | Mbps | O | 0–1000 | 0 | Excess Information Rate for the EVC |

The Service Provider allocates the EVC ID and maintains the Ethernet Virtual Connection for the duration of the
contract.

The EVC is an association of two or more UNIs that limits the exchange of Service
Frames.

The UNI has a port speed of 1 Gbps. Each UNI SHALL have a physical medium and a MAC address. There are
12 such UNIs in the reference deployment.
| Port Speed | Integer | Mbps | M | 10, 100, 1000, 10000 | 1000 | Physical port speed of the UNI |
